name: bess-research-platform
description: Global BESS investment research platform — public static site. Home cockpit + per-market dashboards.

scripts.//test: Scoped globs on purpose. A bare `node --test` discovers every *.test.js under the working tree, including archived copies in tmp/, .tmp/, .claude/worktrees/ and local-data/ backups — those import modules that no longer exist and fail the suite for reasons unrelated to this branch. New test directories must be added here deliberately.
scripts.//test:smoke: The production smoke suite: six routes, structural assertions, both viewports. Runs after a publish against PLATFORM_TEST_BASE_URL; locally it previews the built site. Never the dev server — see AGENTS.md.
scripts.//perf: Diagnostics only — never imported by the site. perf:bundle reads dist/, perf:report rebuilds and measures five routes in a headless browser, and both write perf/performance-baseline.json. See docs/performance-baseline.md.
scripts.//perf:profile: Where the grid map's time goes, by function, from a CDP CPU profile. --unminified builds dist-profile/ so samples carry real names; nothing about the published bundle changes. See docs/p1-svg-performance.md.
scripts.//test:baseline: REGENERATES the frozen fixture — it is not a check. Run test:current to VERIFY that no published number moved; run this only when a number is meant to move, and expect to justify the diff.
